title: Winter Jam
seo_title: Winter Jam 2027 at Great Southern Bank Arena, Springfield
description: Winter Jam 2027 is a night of Christian music and worship featuring Crowder, Anne Wilson, Andy Mineo ft. Magic & Bird, Strings & Heart, Terrian, Red and NewSong, plus a message from speaker Zane Black. A Pre-Jam Party with Natural State, CJ Emulous and Mary-Clair starts the evening, and entry is a $15 donation at the door with no advance tickets required. It takes place Friday, February 19, 2027 at Great Southern Bank Arena in Springfield, MO, with doors and the pre-show at 6:00 PM and the start at 7:00 PM.
